content: We need to find template that does electrophilic bromination of aromatic ring. The forward reaction: aromatic H + Br2 -> aryl bromide + HBr. In retrosynthesis, we need to break C-Br bond to get aryl H (benzene) and Br2? Typically template would be aryl halide -> aryl hydrogen (i.e., remove halogen). The functional groups formed in forward: halide. Broken: hydrogen (i.e., C-H broken). But functional groups list doesn't include hydrogen. Instead we can specify functional_groups_broken maybe none, but we can use bonds broken/formed. We attempted bonds_formed "6-9" etc but not sure. Better to search with functional_groups_formed ["halide"] and maybe functional_groups_broken none. Also maybe specify bonds_broken ["C-H"] but format expects "6-1"? Not sure. Let's just search with functional_groups_formed ["halide"] only.
